This is a production-API-level resource constraint failure localized to the eval probe org's agent quota, not a general service outage. investigation.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on Agent Runtime Endpoint in production-api
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed because the agent runtime endpoint returned a 404, causing a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error that terminated the SSE stream immediately after generation_start. As a result, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract.
investigation.rootCause: The eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1438) and received a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version." This 404 is the earliest violated boundary: the agent runtime harness backing the production-api image generation route was either not deployed, misconfigured (LOCAL_HARNESS_URL / SWARM_BASE_URL pointing to a non-existent or wrong address), or running an incompatible version at the time of the eval run (2026-06-16T04:11:20Z). The failure is localized to the production-api runtime environment and the /api/generate/image/stream endpoint; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so this is an eval-infrastructure or harness-configuration failure, not a confirmed user-facing outage.

possibleCauses: Primary — Agent runtime harness not deployed or unreachable in the production-api environment at eval time: the 404 on SESSION_OPEN_FAILED is the direct signal; LOCAL_HARNESS_URL or SWARM_BASE_URL is either unset, points to a stopped service, or resolves to a host that has no matching route for the image generation session endpoint.

investigations.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on Agent Runtime Endpoint in production-api
investigations.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed because the agent runtime endpoint returned a 404, causing a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error that terminated the SSE stream immediately after generation_start. As a result, the stream never emitted a generation_completed frame and no image URL was produced, violating both assertions in the expected-output contract.
investigations.rootCause: The eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1438) and received a generation_error frame with code SESSION_OPEN_FAILED and the message "agent runtime endpoint not found (404): the harness is unreachable or running an incompatible version." This 404 is the earliest violated boundary: the agent runtime harness backing the production-api image generation route was either not deployed, misconfigured (LOCAL_HARNESS_URL / SWARM_BASE_URL pointing to a non-existent or wrong address), or running an incompatible version at the time of the eval run (2026-06-16T04:11:20Z). The failure is localized to the production-api runtime environment and the /api/generate/image/stream endpoint; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so this is an eval-infrastructure or harness-configuration failure, not a confirmed user-facing outage.
